title: US, South Korea, Japan vow 'complete' North Korea denuclearisation
paragraphs: US, South Korea, Japan vow 'complete' North Korea denuclearisation
They also pledged "full implementation" of UN Security Council resolutions, including a ban on supporting revenue for North Korea's nuclear and ballistic missile programmes.

SEOUL: The United States, South Korea and Japan reaffirmed their commitment to the "complete denuclearisation" of North Korea on Saturday (Oct 31), as Pyongyang continues to reject disarmament ahead of possible talks with Washington.
